sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, SUM("riskmanagement"."incidentcount") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."compscore" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "riskmanagement"."flowlink"  GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink", "dataflow"."chanproto"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, SUM("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT SUM("s2"."m1") AS v FROM "s2") SELECT "s2"."g" AS g, "s2"."m1" AS m1, "s2"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s2"."m1" AS REAL) / "s3"."v") AS m3 FROM "s2" JOIN "s3" ON "s3"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score
why: total of incidents per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto (additive)
(compliance posture score - risk score) / risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto
coarsen to g: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
share of the all total of total of total of incidents (all level)
